value.rationale: For a newly reported record code, knowing only that some standard modification exists does not describe robustness under coordinate choice. The exact minimum-support degree spectrum identifies a strong and previously unstated structural feature: all 184 punctures and all 184 shortenings preserve the best possible one-step distances even though the minimum supports are highly nonuniform. This is a natural invariant of the finite code, directly useful when the parent is used as a seed for further code modifications; it is not an arbitrary coordinate slice or a recomputation of the scalar weight enumerator.
